title: Evolutionary Entropy Shapes Lifespan of the Greenland Shark
summary: The Greenland shark (Somniosus microcephalus) is among the longest-lived vertebrates known, with female maturity estimated at about 156 years and maximum ages approaching four centuries. We use the entropic theory of life histories and an open-group Leslie model to determine which reproductive windows are compatible with this extreme demographic profile. The model yields generation times, reproductive quantiles and entropy-maximizing reproductive endpoints.
